mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the months when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 600.0 thousand units signals a weakening in the residential sector, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the months when HOUST falls below 600.0 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment and rise in unemployment rate indicates a labor market deterioration that signals an impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO < 90), a further decline in industrial production signals worsening supply conditions, which reduces corporate profitability and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods when INDPRO < 90 and INDPRO declines by at least 1.0 index point.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in CPI above 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the months when CPIAUCSL yoy change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the quarters when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), a further rise in unemployment signals economic weakness, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the months when UNRATE > 6.0% and UNRATE rises by at least 0.2 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and a rise in inflation signals aggressive monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL rises simultaneously.
